text: News & Events Events & Archive CHERITech'25 Conference CHERITech'25 Conference A technical conference in Manchester for researchers, engineers, cybersecurity specialists, and product developers working across the CHERI stack. Status Past Format Conference Date 14 November 2025 Location Sister, Manchester, UK Series CHERITech Date: 14th November 2025 Time: 09:00 to 17:00 GMT Location: Sister, Manchester, UK Thank you to all those who attended! Conference Overview CHERITech’25 brought together researchers, technologists, cybersecurity experts, and product developers for a dynamic exploration of Digital Security by Design. Now under the stewardship of the CHERI Alliance, this year’s conference continued its role as a global hub for innovation in CHERI (Capability Hardware Enhanced RISC Instructions) technology. Attendees engaged with industry leaders, shared insights with a vibrant technical community, and explored cutting-edge implementations shaping the future of secure computing.
